name: Flippy
tagline: A daily heads-up on the mint phases your wallets are actually allowed into.
description: For anyone following several OpenSea drops and losing track of who qualifies for what. Once a day it lists the phases currently open, lines them up against the wallets you name, and adds a quick sense of how loud the drop is on X. It only reads and reports: no signing, no minting, no trading on your behalf.
author: diegoarmandoAD
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
